_sagegui.name: Tryptic — tight
_sagegui.description: Tight precursor window: 10 ppm MS1, 20 ppm MS2, with isotope_errors -1 to +3 handling monoisotopic peak misassignment instead of a wide Da window. Same enzyme and modification base as the high-res go-to. Start here for well-calibrated Orbitrap DDA. The 20 ppm MS2 is sageRecon's validated Orbitrap/FT-ICR recommendation; only the MS1 window separates this from the wide template.
